messages:
rachel_prod: Quick announce: Nebula models (nebula-1, nebula-1-lite) are GA on Hosted. Includes streaming schema v3 + experimental toolcall multiplexer. Full migration guide: https://intranet.redwood/nebula-ga :tada:

ops-bot: deploy: hosted/nebula/ga -> succeeded 1791234567 :white_check_mark:

omar_eng: Nice. Rollout plan? Canary or full?

rachel_prod: Phased canary: 5% for 2h, 20% for 4h, then 100% if stable. Fallback route set to nebula-1-quant.

nina_cs: CS note: prepping an outbound email + FAQ for Dedicated customers. Any breaking changes?

rachel_prod: Non-multiplexed streams are backward compatible. If you use multiplexing update SDK to >=3.6.1. Well publish example client diffs.

omar_eng: Dev note: streaming v3 changes framing for multiplexed toolcalls. Ensure ingress proxies (edge-gateway/nginx) are >= v2.4 to avoid truncated frames.

leo_sre: Canary watchlist: nebula-canary-watch (p95/p99 latency, error-rate, token-cost, hallucination-score). I'll monitor during the 5% window.

omar_eng: Also minor change to stop-sequence semantics vs older families; run eval suites if you rely on exact boundaries.

zoe_marketing: I'll draft the blog and internal FAQ. Nina, want me to include CS ticket examples?

nina_cs: Yes please. I'll DM top Dedicated customers and flag those who asked for lower-latency variants.

rachel_prod: Deprecation: realtime-v1 endpoints deprecated in 60 days; 30-day compatibility shim will auto-redirect but please update SDKs. Migration steps in the guide.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled -> realtime-v1-deprecation-email queued for 7 days before deadline.
